items.title: Eastern Natural Gas Prices Roar Back, Claim Lion’s Share of Gains
items.summary: Natural gas spot prices surged across the Northeast and Appalachia on Monday, shaking off an exceptionally warm weather outlook as regional production declined. Western markets also strengthened amid a sharp reduction in Canadian pipeline flows.

items.title: Natural Gas Bulls Find a Pulse Beneath the Pressure

items.title: LNG Buying Steady in Asia, Europe Despite Soaring Prices
items.summary: Asian and European natural gas prices continued to rise Monday as LNG buying is steady in both regions ahead of winter and geopolitical tensions remain high in the Middle East.

items.title: Balmy Halloween Forecasts Scare Natural Gas Bulls as November Bidweek Opens
items.summary: November bidweek natural gas trading opened Monday with the prompt month sliding toward $2.500/MMBtu, as forecasts for a mild start to the heating season pulled the rug out from under futures.

items.title: Canadian LNG Development Advances With Ksi Lisims SPA, Cedar Progress
items.summary: Ksi Lisims LNG has finalized a 20-year supply agreement with Germany's SEFE, advancing commercialization of the proposed British Columbia export project as Canada’s next wave of LNG developments continues to take shape.

items.title: Leidy Natural Gas Supply Swamps Transco Zones 5 and 6 as Takeaway Capacity Tightens
items.summary: Transco market-zone basis appeared to be back under pressure on Friday (Oct. 23) following some recent tightening.

items.title: As Weather Catalysts Dodge Lower 48, Natural Gas Price Pressure Festers
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures stumbled through midday trading on Monday as mild fall weather and rising production overshadowed LNG demand strength. However, prices were up from intraday lows.

items.title: EQT Positions for ‘Next Era’ with Deal to Create US Natural Gas Giant
items.summary: EQT continued its buying spree Monday, announcing that it would acquire Appalachian heavyweight Range Resources in an all-stock deal that would create the nation’s largest natural gas producer.

items.title: US NatGas Storage Build Seen Below Average as LNG Hits New Highs
items.summary: NGI is forecasting the next US Energy Information Administration (EIA) Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report for the week ended Oct. 23 shows an injection of 68 Bcf, down 9 Bcf week/week.
